headline: Anthropic commits $11.6 billion to Akamai cloud services

supports: Anthropic committed $11.6 billion to Akamai cloud services over seven years.
Akamai issued a warrant that could give Anthropic up to about 5% of Akamai common stock.
The relationship could expand by an additional $9 billion.

source_records.source_name: Akamai Technologies (company announcement distributed by GlobeNewswire)
supports: The contractual commitment is $11.6 billion over seven years.
The deal supports Anthropic CPU workloads using Akamai Cloud infrastructure and software.
Potential expansion is up to an additional $9 billion and the warrant can represent up to approximately 5% of Akamai common stock outstanding.

caption:
🇪🇸 Anthropic acordó un compromiso de US$11.600 millones durante siete años para utilizar servicios de nube de Akamai, destinados a respaldar sus cargas de trabajo de CPU. Akamai también emitió un warrant que podría dar a Anthropic una participación de hasta aproximadamente 5% de sus acciones ordinarias, con parte de esa participación vinculada a una posible expansión del acuerdo.

🇺🇸 Anthropic agreed to an $11.6 billion seven-year commitment for Akamai cloud services to support its CPU workloads. Akamai also issued a warrant that could give Anthropic a stake of up to approximately 5% of its common stock, with part of that stake tied to a potential expansion of the agreement.

Sources: Reuters / Akamai — Sept. 24, 2026.
